title: Neo4j Graph Elements
description: Schema for Neo4j graph data elements including nodes and relationships returned by Cypher queries.

nodes.description: Array of graph nodes in the result set

relationships.description: Array of graph relationships in the result set

Node.description: A node in the Neo4j graph representing an entity with labels and properties.

id.description: The internal element ID of the node

labels.description: Labels assigned to the node, representing the types or categories it belongs to

properties.description: Key-value properties stored on the node

Relationship.description: A directed relationship between two nodes in the Neo4j graph with a type and properties.

id.description: The internal element ID of the relationship

type.description: The relationship type, representing the nature of the connection between nodes

startNode.description: The element ID of the start node

endNode.description: The element ID of the end node

properties.description: Key-value properties stored on the relationship

Path.description: A path through the graph consisting of alternating nodes and relationships.

nodes.description: Ordered array of nodes along the path

relationships.description: Ordered array of relationships connecting the nodes along the path

QueryStatistics.description: Statistics about the execution of a Cypher query including counts of created, modified, and deleted elements.

contains_updates.description: Whether the query modified the database

nodes_created.description: Number of nodes created by the query

nodes_deleted.description: Number of nodes deleted by the query

properties_set.description: Number of properties set on nodes or relationships

relationships_created.description: Number of relationships created by the query

relationships_deleted.description: Number of relationships deleted by the query

labels_added.description: Number of labels added to nodes

labels_removed.description: Number of labels removed from nodes
